rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This CBN MCP server provides access to Central Bank of Nigeria circulars and regulatory documents through the official CBN API integration. Built with Dart using the mcp_server_dart framework and featuring comprehensive PDF document handling, it offers tools for fetching, searching, and filtering CBN circulars by date range and category, plus specialized LLM-friendly endpoints that provide direct PDF URLs for AI analysis of regulatory content. The implementation includes robust error handling with Dio HTTP client, automatic PDF URL resolution, and specialized prompt templates for regulatory compliance analysis, making it valuable for financial institutions, compliance teams, and regulatory analysts who need AI-assisted access to Nigerian banking regulations and policy documents.
